about: Every save source the converter accepts and every migration between save formats. Hand-maintained; see SAVE_COMPATIBILITY_RUNBOOK.md. Untagged sources (released before the save header existed) are recognised by the SHA-256 of the patched ROM the player played them with. A migration is listed only once its acceptance gates have passed; 'verified' records how.
